title: Layard finds the Library of Ashurbanipal at Nineveh

tellings.quote: in 1848 18 49 Austin Henry lard is Excavating the ancient city of Nineveh and what today is mosul Iraq

plain: In 1848 and 1849 an explorer named Austen Henry Layard was digging up the ancient city of Nineveh, in what is now Mosul, Iraq, where he found the royal library of an ancient king named Ashurbanipal. Matt LaCroix, a researcher of ancient civilizations, tells this to Michels without naming a source. He brings it up because the writings in that library are, for him, a key to a lost chapter of human history going back thousands of years.
